name: Okril'lon Hold
summary: Perched in the northwestern crags of the Blasted Lands, this fortified stronghold was originally built by the Old Horde as Rockard during the First War. In the current era of 25 ADP, it is firmly occupied by the brutal Dreadmaul ogres under the name Dreadmaul Hold. The encampment serves as a fortified redoubt overlooking the scorched red plains below.

sections.title: From Rockard to Dreadmaul Hold
sections.body: Long before the scorched expanse of the Blasted Lands emerged from the Black Morass, orcish invaders constructed Rockard alongside Stonard as one of the first settlements established on Azeroth after the Dark Portal opened. Though it survived the devastation of both the First and Second Wars, the departing orcs could not hold it. The Dreadmaul clan of ogres stormed the fortress, driving out any remaining defenders and claiming the stone towers and blacksmith for themselves. Renamed Dreadmaul Hold, it now serves as the primary garrison of the region's ogre population.

sections.title: A Den of Ogre Supremacy
sections.body: Under the iron rule of Grol the Destroyer, Dreadmaul Hold has become a nexus of brute force and dark allegiances. Enslaved or allied to the dreadlord Razelikh the Defiler, the ogres guard key mountain paths leading north toward the Swamp of Sorrows. Travelers and Horde supply trains skirting the northern mountains must remain ever vigilant against raiding warbands surging out of its gates.

faq.q: Why is this place called Dreadmaul Hold instead of Okril'lon Hold?
faq.answer: In 25 ADP, the stronghold is known solely as Dreadmaul Hold. It was seized by the Dreadmaul ogres following the Second War.

It was originally built as Rockard, an early outpost of the Old Horde established in the Black Morass shortly after the Dark Portal opened during the First War, making it one of the oldest orc settlements on Azeroth.

faq.q: Who rules Dreadmaul Hold right now?
faq.answer: The hold is led by the ogre warlord Grol the Destroyer, who commands the Dreadmaul clan in the Blasted Lands and serves the demon Razelikh the Defiler.

faq.q: Is the Horde in control of this base?
faq.answer: No. The fortress is entirely hostile to both the Horde and the Alliance, occupied solely by the Dreadmaul ogres.

angles.text: Rockard was one of your people's earliest footholds on this world, and seeing it defiled and overrun by Dreadmaul ogres is a bitter reminder of the Old Horde's scattered collapse.
Sitting right on the northern threshold of the Blasted Lands, the fortified hold represents a constant threat of ogre warbands ambushing patrols riding south from the Swamp of Sorrows.
